verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs explicitly state each API endpoint has a built-in, in-context API explorer for making requests and viewing responses (asana-docs-16), backed by a RESTful reference (asana-docs-15) and an official OpenAPI spec repo (asana-supp-openapi-spec, asana-docs-20), plus a developer sandbox for safe testing (asana-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the explorer's runnable examples in practice, and a working public openapi.json endpoint (probe found 404s at standard paths).
